title: Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners report relative to the acceptance of the Juvenile Justice Crime Prevention Act grant award from the Los Angeles…
text:
[Council File 26-1483]
Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners report relative to the acceptance of the Juvenile Justice Crime Prevention Act grant award from the Los Angeles County Probation Department for the After School Enrichment and Supervision Program provided through the Clean and Safe Spaces (CLASS) Parks Youth Employment Internship Program. (This matter is also referred to the Budget and Finance Committee.)
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Accepts a county Juvenile Justice Crime Prevention Act grant from LA County Probation for Recreation and Parks' after-school enrichment program tied to the CLASS Parks youth internship program.
